engineering_interpretation: This table defines the control logic and status feedback mechanisms for direction lights between the ICB and various direction light control units (LHZCU, RHZCU, RZCU). It specifies how control signals are converted to CAN signals, timing distributions, and the status/error reporting of direction lights. This is primarily used for testing the correct signal conversion, timing behavior, and error handling of direction light systems in vehicle electronics.
